content: JISAS KIYALAA LƗGA LAATNDƗ
Njɨvwa lapman nandinya ngɨlɨndɨ maa Sande ngambi Magdalana taagwa Mariagwi nat Mario Jisas taagndi ta waangu vɨvat ngambi gleimba laataa yimbɨt.
Yilɨmbɨt maa yɨnaw kiyandɨ, nyɨnangwupmba lɨga ensel ngaga yandɨ. Yalaa waangu tegɨlɨnja kambak mbandɨga kalilaa wungi kambak tagumba ndaa lɨndɨ.
Enselna mɨndama vlap vlap wandɨ, kembandɨ vɨna vla ndɨna mɨndama wupma lɨndɨ. ndɨna waavwi sawun mɨna lɨndɨ.
Waangu vɨga la Soldia ensel kat vɨlaa ava mban plaga vaaka lɨga yiga kɨpmamba ndandi. ndalaa kiyalaa la nɨmba vla lɨndi.
Taagwa vɨlɨlɨk yambɨt maa ensel mbɨk kat vɨlaa wandɨ. Diwai krosmba kaalanja Jisas kat kwaaka vɨvat yambɨt. Vɨga lɨgowun mbɨk kat.
Ndɨ kumba waangumba ana lɨgandɨ. Tamba laataa yindɨ. Tamba Jisas wandɨ. Kiyalaa lɨga ngɨni laakiyowun wandɨ. Wanda vapmba laatndɨ. Tɨnda waangu yaa vɨ mbɨla.

Mbɨk kwiyatapman yiga vɨmba vat ndɨna mbaapmamba la nɨmba kat yiga mbuikiyambɨt. Kiyalaa lɨga laataa Galiliat yindɨ. Ngwuk ndɨna kwupmba aymba ngwuk. yiga mbupmba ngwuk. Mbɨk kat wawa nyaangɨt mbɨtna maawut ke tɨvɨga waa wandɨ ensel.
Wandɨ maa waangu kwagalalaa pɨlɨga yimbɨt. Vaaka yelavɨka solat sɨga yimbɨt. Yiga Jisasna mbaapmamba la nɨmba kat mbupmat yimbɨt.
Yilɨmbɨt maa Jisas ava yambɨmba mbɨk kat vɨlaa wandɨ. apma vat alɨmba mbɨt waa wandɨ, wutna kwali kwali ndaa sɨlaa ndɨna mamba kwutaa ndɨna sɨ kwutaa katsoga wambɨt.
Jisas mbɨk kat wandɨ. Mbɨk ke vapmba. Tak Galiliat yiga tɨgowun. Wuna mbaapmamba la nɨimba kat ambukmba mbɨk. Mpupmbɨk, wutaa wuna kwupmba yalaa wun kat vɨgandi waa wandɨ Jisas.
SOLDIA WAA NYAANGƗT
Wumbɨt taagwa yilɨmbɨt maa waangu kat vɨga la nat soldia laataa ngepmat yindi. Yiga God kat kwunatɨga njambwi nɨmba kat Jisas laatnda vak mbutndi.
Mbutndi maa God kat kwunatɨga njambwi nɨmbo Judana nɨma nɨmbo yisolaa nyaangɨt ngambundi. Nyaangɨt ngambulaga soldia kat nɨma sakwat sanya kwilaa wandi.
Ngwuk kupma ambukmba ngwuk. Ngan sɨndu kwanɨn maa Jisasna mbaapmamba la nɨmba yalaa ndɨna sɨm sɨkwuta kalindi waa ambukmba ngwuk nat nɨmba kat.
Ngwuk kat vɨga la njambwi nayan mbukngweya nyaangɨt wutaa ngwuk kat kai wandeyan ndɨ kat yiga waiganɨn. Wamɨn maa ngwuk kat ana sɨga viyaigandɨ waa wandi Judana njambwi nɨmba.
Soldia wutaa kwinja sanya klalaa wanja nyaangɨtmba waa ndinyangu kat yiga mbutndi. Soldia waa nyaangɨt wuka lɨga apma vala wangwa waa Juda walɨndi. Mbambala nɨmbun wupma walɨgandi.
JISAS NDƗNA MBAAPMA NƗMBA KAT NJƗVWA KWINDƗ
Tak Jisas wanda Galilimba lɨga nduwi Jisasna mbaapmamba la tamba vɨli kiyeli kɨta nɨmba wokendi.
Wokelaa Jisas kat vɨlagala solat sɨga ngu navɨn vɨyaa ndɨ kat tɨndi. Ndɨ kat nat nɨmba vɨlaa lɨga Jisas ana ndɨ waa maawupmba yelavɨka lɨndi.
Jisas ndi kat yalaa ngwaymba lɨga wandɨ. Nyinangwutna kwondu kɨpmana kwondu aywaa tamba klalaa lɨgowun.
Kan kwondu ngwuk kat kwiwun mala klalaa ngepma ngepma aywaa yigiyangwuk. Wuna nyaekna sɨ waga wuna sɨ waga wuna nyaekna waagana sɨ waga ndi kat ngu yagugiyangwuk.

Ngwuk kat mbutuwun, wutaa yetɨngwa nyaangɨt ndi kat mbukngwuk maa kwutaa yetɨgiyandi. Ngwuk kɨta nda kat wana yelavɨtapman yilɨngweya. Ngwuk kat ana kwagalagiyowun. Ngwutnogwinala njɨmbla njɨmbla tɨgiyowun. Ngwulogwi tɨlɨwun, kɨpma nyinangwut ngɨlɨgiyandi ngɨni la lɨga nandinya waa wandɨ Jisas.
